6302.title: Background unread events reset sidebar collapse state
6302.rootCauseOneLine: The reveal state machine treats background unread arrivals as navigation and removes their group IDs from persisted collapse preferences.
6302.proposedFix: Reveal containing groups only on explicit thread navigation; keep background activity in existing collapsed-header indicators.
6302.caveats: No browser screenshots: Chrome cannot start because system libraries are missing. Linux production-state reproduction repeated twice; macOS release behavior and actual provider spawning were not exercised.
